title: Plugin-driver row cap is fixed at 1000 with no paging: a gantt over a virtual object (the #27130 recipe) fails with 422 once its tree passes 1000 rows
body:
**Edition:** ObjectOS Enterprise (licensed, self-managed)
**Version:** 18.2.0 in production. The virtual-object route is evaluated against 18.3.0 (`origin/main` `0b2b309c`).

## Background

#27130 (closed) was answered with the virtual-object recipe: a plugin driver behind an external object, with the gantt bound to that object (`content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx`). Our production-scheduling gantt is a four-level tree: project → product → plan → work order. The project and product rows are synthetic group rows that the driver computes.

**We expect the tree to reach about 5,000 rows**, counting plans and their work orders as they accumulate. We have not measured this yet. A gantt shows the whole tree at once, so one list read has to return all of those rows.

## What happens

Read on `origin/main` `0b2b309c`, `packages/objectql/src/external-driver-floor.ts`:

- The floor sends the driver `limit: EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP + 1` (`:199`). It never sends `offset`, so the driver cannot page.
- More than `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP` (1000, `external-driver-errors.ts:37`) rows back throws `EXTERNAL_ROW_CAP_EXCEEDED` (422, `:214`). The guide confirms this: "the cap is fixed and not configurable", and "when more than 1000 rows match, every page of that read is refused".
- So once the tree passes 1000 matching rows, **the whole gantt fails with a 422**. It is not truncated. It works in testing and breaks in production as data grows.

The guide's remedies do not fit this case:

- **Narrow the filter.** This helps only as long as the narrowed set stays under 1000. A planner who widens the date range or clears a quick filter gets the 422 again.
- **Mirror the data into a real object.** This brings back the snapshot table we removed. A stored copy is stale until the next sync, and the next sync overwrites a planner's edits. The guide itself says to make the object virtual when "a stored copy is yesterday's answer".

## Request

One of the following:

- **(a) A per-datasource cap.** For example `external.rowCap` on the datasource, bounded by a platform maximum, so an operator who knows the source can raise it.
- **(b) Bring forward the trusted-driver tier from #27261.** A driver that passes the plugin-driver conformance kit would be trusted with `offset`, `limit` and pagination, and the cap would then apply per page, not per match set.
- **(c) At minimum, document it.** Add a section to the guide on views that read the whole set at once (gantt, tree, calendar, map), and what to do when that set exceeds 1000.

## Related

- #27130 (the original report), #27261 (epic; the trusted tier is its later phase), #27277 (the floor and the cap)
